name: Shuttle board
summary: A split-flap departures board pinned to the group, built from the official shuttle schedule: each run flaps its day, time, stop and seats left, the last run blinks, and members tap a run and say they're on it to see who they're riding with.
useWhen: when does the airport shuttle run before break
is there a bus to the airport friday
what time is the last shuttle
can someone post the break shuttle times again
dontUseWhen: carpooling in friends' cars (use event-carpool or carpool)
a one-off ride to pick someone up (use pickup-run)
booking flights or splitting a cab fare

to.description: Where the shuttle goes, short, e.g. 'BDL airport'

asked.description: How many times it was asked in the group

runs.description: Up to 6 runs from the official schedule, in order

outside.description: Riders already booked from outside the chat

riders.description: Chat members on this run, by name

last.description: True for the last run before break

said.description: What riders said, in their words
